# Mentor Success Academy

> Mentor Success Academy (MSA) is a 12-week mentor training program that teaches experienced preschool teachers how to mentor and coach other early childhood teachers, built on MSA's LEAP framework.

Mentor Success Academy trains the mentor, not just the mentee. Each week the mentor completes a short online training module on their own time, then meets with a mentee teacher for 30-45 minutes to put that week's skills into practice. After 12 weeks, the mentor keeps those skills for the next teacher they support, and can earn the annual MSA Certified Mentor credential.

LEAP (Leadership Expression Assessment Profile) is the framework inside Mentor Success Academy's training. It helps mentors adapt their coaching to each teacher's natural leadership expression: four core expressions (Driver, Inspirer, Sustainer, Cultivator) and 12 blends, for 16 profiles. Mentor Success Academy is not affiliated with any other program that uses the name LEAP, including youth mentoring programs.

## Key facts

- Name: Mentor Success Academy (MSA)
- What it is: online mentor training for experienced early childhood teachers who mentor other teachers
- Who it serves: licensed early childhood programs in the United States; written for mentors of teachers of preschool-age children (2½-5)
- Length: 12 weeks, one module and one 30-45 minute mentor-mentee meeting per week
- Curriculum: three focus areas of four weeks each
  - Weeks 1-4: Emotional Climate & Responsiveness
  - Weeks 5-8: Classroom Organization
  - Weeks 9-12: Instructional Support
- Framework: MSA's LEAP framework (Leadership Expression Assessment Profile)
- Tools: weekly reflections for mentors and mentees, the Quality Interaction Framework (QIF) for classroom observations, a director dashboard, and a coaching call library
- Credential: MSA Certified Mentor (annual)
- Founders: Mary Wardlaw, Ed.S., MBA, and Rebecca Munlyn
- Contact: info@mentorsuccessacademy.com

## Ways to join

- [Free research trial](https://mentorsuccessacademy.com/research-trial): a 3-month trial beginning January 2027, part of Mary Wardlaw's doctoral research on mentoring in early childhood programs. Participating mentors receive the training (valued at $1,200) at no cost. Open to licensed, privately owned US programs with at least 2 classrooms serving children 2½ and older.
- [Center membership](https://mentorsuccessacademy.com/membership): paid monthly per mentor, with discounts for 2 or more mentors. Start any time, no research requirements, cancel online.

## Founders

- [Mary Wardlaw, Ed.S., MBA](https://mentorsuccessacademy.com/founders): co-founder of Mentor Success Academy. Early childhood educator since 1992, founder of The Children's Center in southwest Michigan (2002) and National CDA Training (2019). Grew The Children's Center from 3 teachers and 17 children to 80 teachers and over 250 children. Ph.D. student in Early Childhood Education researching the training, mentoring and retention of early childhood teachers. Full bio: https://mary-wardlaw.com
- [Rebecca Munlyn](https://mentorsuccessacademy.com/founders): co-founder of Mentor Success Academy and founder and CEO of Inspired Growth, LLC. Leader and team development consultant with more than 20 years of coaching and consulting experience.
